opinions.text: *931C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of Consolidated Edison Co. of New York, Inc., et al., for leave to file a brief, as amici curiae, in No. 671, granted. Cer-tiorari granted. Cases consolidated and a total of four hours allotted for oral argument.
